description: This PHP source file defines the AssignClaimRequestController class within the OrangeHRM Claim module. It handles the pre-render setup for assigning claim requests, including role and access validation, and prepares a VueJS component for rendering the assign claim interface.

classes.name: AssignClaimRequestController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling assignment of claim requests. It includes methods to prepare the assignment component and verify user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with claim requester details and configuration, redirects if the user is the requester.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has access to view or modify the specified claim request based on their role and the request ID.
